title: Ground Sprint Overlay (Speed Boost + Vignette)
description:
Purpose: Layer sprint behaviour on top of active sliding locomotion (head-relative or controller-relative). Adds Left Thumbstick Click sprint with optional vignette, gentle acceleration, cooldown, and audio/haptic cues. Does not implement base locomotion itself; relies on builtin.locomotion.slide.* being active.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- Left Thumbstick for walk/strafe.
- Left Thumbstick Click triggers Sprint on ground for a short burst with optional vignette.
- Right Thumbstick handles turning (snap/smooth, configured elsewhere).

Params (read from CMechanicBinding::Entry::params_json):
- sprint_speed_multiplier (float, default 1.6).
- sprint_accel_tau_s (float, default 0.10) and sprint_decel_tau_s (float, default 0.18).
- sprint_max_duration_s (float, default 2.0), sprint_cooldown_s (float, default 2.0).
- vignette_on_sprint (bool, default true).
- vignette_intensity_override (float, default -1.0; if <0 use value from locomotion_options_ui ComfortBus).
- deadzone_override (float, default -1.0; if >=0 overrides base deadzone to 0.18..0.25 comfort range).

Behaviour:
1) Detects grounded state via CPhysics (contact normals up-dot > 0.7). Sprint only engages when grounded and a slide locomotion mechanic is active.
2) On Left Thumbstick Click press:
   - If off cooldown, set sprint_active=true, latch a timer, increase the player's target speed scalar by sprint_speed_multiplier, and start haptic pulse (light start tick). If cooldown active, ignore.
3) While sprint_active:
   - Apply a speed scalar to the slide velocity target. Respect accel/decel taus for comfort. If vignette_on_sprint, publish vignette intensity to CComfortState (from locomotion_options_ui) and ramp it up/down on engage/release.
   - If Left Thumbstick magnitude drops below deadzone or max_duration_s is hit, end sprint and start cooldown.
4) On sprint end:
   - Smoothly ease target speed back to baseline. Fire a short cooldown UI chip on wrist and prevent re-trigger until cooldown elapses.

Components:
- Reads: CInput (stick states), CPhysics (grounded), CComfortState (vignette), CTransform (for orientation), CPlayer locomotion state.
- Writes: CLocomotionScalar (a scalar multiplier consumed by the engine's slide locomotion blend), CComfortState vignette_level, CHapticsEvent for start/stop.

Comfort/safety:
- Gentle ramps on engage/release; no camera roll; optional vignette. Ignores sprint in mid-air/hover/flight.

Acceptance hooks:
- During test_ground_sprint_vignette, pressing Left Stick Click increases speed visibly; vignette appears if enabled; halts on release with audible cue.

Integration and depends_on:
- Reads vignette defaults from locomotion_options_ui ComfortBus if vignette_intensity_override < 0.
- Compatible with builtin.locomotion.slide.head_relative and builtin.locomotion.slide.controller_relative.
- Depends on haptics_manager for haptic pattern ids (“sprint_start”, “sprint_end”).

Assets/scenes:
- Global; exercised in central_battery_plaza and alien_city_attack.

Suggested file split: ground_sprint_overlay_register.cpp, ground_sprint_overlay_update.cpp.
